We further conduct human evaluation to analyze the translation quality. We respectively randomly pick 100 sentences from Zh ⇒ En and De ⇒ En test sets, and recruit three human judges for evaluation. For each sentence, the judges read the source sentence and two candidate translations, which are from the random subset model and G-DIG subset model. The judges are required to rate each candidate on a scale of 1 to 5 and pick the better one.
